actions.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Make a production sprite sheet of SIX frames, precise 3 columns x 2 rows, for the SAME original whale daughter desktop pet. Preserve her blue-cyan long hair, blue fin ears and tail, loop ahoge, lace headband, navy LONG-SLEEVE maid dress, white whale-emblem apron on front, white tights and navy shoes, exact chibi face and proportions. Fixed camera and character scale, generous 12% TRANSPARENT alpha margins per cell, six fully separate full bodies, no floor, no labels or effects. This is SLOW RELAXED LOW-STEP WALKING, not marching, running, knee lifting or skipping. KNEES STAY ALMOST STRAIGHT beneath skirt in EVERY frame. BOTH SHOES stay VERY CLOSE to the imaginary ground in EVERY frame; maximum vertical difference between the soles is only 8 pixels for a 500-pixel-tall character. Short strides, heels gently roll off ground, elbows relaxed DOWN BESIDE WAIST with tiny opposite arm swing. NEVER bend a calf back at right angles, NEVER raise a knee toward waist, NEVER lift a shoe near the skirt. Body stays upright, weight bob only 1-2 pixels. Six chronological phases: right heel slightly forward/left toe slightly behind; right leg supports while left shoe skims ground; left shoe swings just forward barely above floor; left heel slightly forward/right toe slightly behind; left leg supports while right shoe skims floor; right shoe swings forward almost touching floor. Keep right and left legs distinguishable and alternate support. All six equally spaced. VIEW: FRONT 3/4 facing viewer RIGHT, face and front apron emblem visible. Reference image supplies identity, not the walking pose.
